newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks run up on U.S. PPI data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks run up on U.S. PPI data.

text.p: French shares added gains following news of a 0.3 percent drop in U.S. May producer prices data. The market had been expecting 0.1 percent rise in the core index.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 39.21 points or 1.42 percent at 2,799.48 at 1233 GMT. The index had been up 0.98 percent just before the U.S. report.
The CAC-40 futures contract was up 40 points at 2,786 from Thursday's close.
